colour_basic_desc: No special effects at all for anything, overrides all other options and deco
colour_default_desc: Displays elements with their normal colours
colour_gradient_desc: Changes colors of elements slightly to show heat diffusing through them
colour_heat_desc: Displays temperatures of the elements, dark blue is coldest, pink is hottest
colour_life_desc: Displays the life value of elements in greyscale gradients
decoration_colour_desc: Colour the decoration tools blend over the element display. Click a swatch, or open the picker for any RGB/HSV value
disp_alt_velocity_desc: Displays pressure as red and blue, and velocity as white
disp_ambient_heat_desc: Displays the temperature of the air like heat display does
disp_effects_desc: Enables moving solids, stickmen guns, and premium(tm) graphics
disp_gravity_grid_desc: Draw the Newtonian gravity force vectors
disp_gravity_lensing_desc: Gravity lensing, Newtonian Gravity bends light with this on
disp_persistent_desc: Element paths persist on the screen for a while
disp_pressure_desc: Displays pressure, red is positive and blue is negative
disp_velocity_desc: Displays velocity and positive pressure: up/down adds blue, right/left adds red, still pressure adds green
disp_vorticity_desc: Displays vorticity, red is clockwise and blue is anticlockwise
fire_intensity_desc: Strength of the additive fire glow
heat_range_no_samples: Auto: no samples in the sampled area yet
ren_basic_desc: Basic rendering, without this, most things will be invisible
ren_blob_desc: Makes everything be drawn like a blob
ren_effects_desc: Adds Special flare effects to some elements
title: Render
